blocks.text: Lewis nazariye ke mutabiq ionic bond kam ionization energy wale atom se zyada electron affinity wale doosre atom ko electrons ki mukammal muntaqili (transfer) se banta hai. Sodium atom (Na, 2, 8, 1) apna sab se bairooni electron kho kar Na+ ion (2, 8) banane ka rujhan rakhta hai, jis ki electron configuration neon ki hai, us ke qareeb tareen noble gas. Chlorine atom (2, 8, 7) ek electron le kar chloride ion Cl- (2, 8, 8) banata hai, aur agli noble gas ki electron tarteeb pata hai. Mukhalif charge wale Na+ aur Cl- ions NaCl ke crystal mein mazboot ionic bond se jure hain. Isi qism ka bond groups 1 aur 2 ke metals aur groups 16 aur 17 ke anasir ke darmiyan mutawaqqa hai.

blocks.alt: Shells ke diagram. Sodium atom (2, 8, 1) apna akela bahari electron chlorine atom (2, 8, 7) ko de deta hai. Nateeje mein sodium ion Na+ (shells 2, 8) aur chloride ion Cl- (shells 2, 8, 8) bante hain jo aik doosre ko khenchte hain, NaCl. Sodium ke electrons crosses aur chlorine ke dots hain.
blocks.caption: Na aur Cl ke darmiyan ionic bond banna (Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Magnesium 2, 8, 2 hai aur oxygen 2, 6. Lewis nazariye se magnesium oxide ka ionic bond bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Magnesium, group 2 ka metal kam ionization energy ke saath, apne dono bairooni electrons kho kar Mg2+ (2, 8, neon jaisa) banta hai. Oxygen, group 16 ka unsur zyada electron affinity ke saath, dono electrons le kar O2- (2, 8, neon jaisa) banta hai. Mukhalif charge wale ions MgO crystal mein zor se khinchte hain.

items: Ionic bond: kam ionization energy wale atom se zyada electron affinity wale atom ko electrons ki mukammal muntaqili; Na (2, 8, 1) Na+ (2, 8) deta hai aur Cl (2, 8, 7) Cl- (2, 8, 8), mazboot kashish se jure. Groups 1 aur 2 aur groups 16 aur 17 ke darmiyan mutawaqqa.
